messages:
Priya: Heads-up — Bellatrix reported a drop on their invoice-extraction accuracy after we merged their LoRA into the DeltaFusion scaffold. Can we triage?
Dan: Got it. Do we have baseline numbers and which quant/precision they ran?
Priya: Baseline (FP16 + LoRA v1) on our quickprobe-8: invoices exact-match 0.842. After merge + int3 quant: 0.781. They surfaced tokenization oddities too.
Bellatrix-PS: (customer) We see more truncated amounts and weird commas. Appears after yesterday's merge + small quant rollout.
Mike: Thanks. Suspect tokenizer mapping plus int3 quant bucketization. Need quick reproducer. Priya — can you paste the merge command used?
Priya: Here’s what the engineer ran:```bash
redwood merge --base deltafusion-v2 --adapter bellatrix-lora-v1 \ 
  --out bellatrix-merged-df2 --quant int3 --preserve-tokenizer false
```
Alisa: Ah — `--preserve-tokenizer false` likely replaced the adapter tokenizer entries. If tokenizer changed, token ids shift and extraction heuristics break.
Dan: Can we run a fast diff: tokenizer vocab mapping + run quickprobe-8 with FP16 vs int3 keeping tokenizer preserved? I can spin a job on a dev GPU.
Mike: I’ll create a small eval pack focused on invoice amounts (30 prompts) and run: fp16+merged, int3+preserve-tokenizer, int3+no-preserve. See which axis causes drop.
Priya: Eval pack name `bellatrix-amount-quickprobe-v1`. Prompts cover commas, parentheses, currency symbols, and hyphenated amounts.
Dan: Starting run now. Command:```bash
redwood eval run --model bellatrix-merged-df2 --pack bellatrix-amount-quickprobe-v1 --batch 8 --out /tmp/bellatrix-eval
```
deploy-bot: job started (job-id: jb_2026_103). ETA ~12m.
Bellatrix-PS: Appreciate the quick response. If tokenizer is the cause, we can re-run on our side once you confirm settings.
Mike: Initial results (quick scan):
- FP16 + preserve-tokenizer: exact-match 0.840
- int3 + preserve-tokenizer: exact-match 0.833
- int3 + no-preserve-tokenizer: exact-match 0.679
So the big drop is tokenizer replacement. int3 itself is a small hit.
Priya: Great, that matches theory. Action: revert `--preserve-tokenizer false` for customer merges, and add a pre-merge check that warns if tokenizer delta > 0.05 token-id shift.
Dan: I’ll open a tiny PR to add the pre-merge check and a `--force-tokenizer-replace` flag so merges are explicit about tokenizer swaps.
Mike: Also recommend adding a short CI eval (5 prompts) that runs post-merge sanity for amounts and dates. If drop > 0.05, block auto-promotion.
Priya: Agreed. Bellatrix — we'll coordinate a safe re-merge (int3 + preserve tokenizer) and push a patch to the merge tool this morning.
Bellatrix-PS: Thanks team. Please ping when the re-merge is ready and we’ll smoke test on prod mirror.
Alisa: Note for release notes: document that tokenizer replacement is opt-in and list common failures (amounts, currency punctuation).
Priya: Filing notes and PR links in the thread when ready. Thanks!
